description_en: Queries the device trace of an ApsaraMQ for MQTT client by paging. When a device encounters an exception, you can call this operation to query the connection history of the specified device to help you quickly identify the cause of the exception
description_zh: 分页查询微消息队列MQTT版客户端的设备轨迹。当设备的状态出现异常时，您可以通过该接口查询指定设备的连接历史，帮助您快速定位异常原因
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt query-mqtt-trace-device --mqtt-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id mqtt-cn-i7m26mf0000 --client-id GID_test@@@producer --begin-time 1621580400000 --end-time 1621584000000 --current-page 1 --page-size 5 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMqttTraceDevice

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181438.html
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例地域（Region）的ID。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181438.html
parameters.name: mqtt_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. This value must match the instance ID that the client actually uses. You can view the instance ID in the Basic Information area on the Instance Details page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在控制台实例详情页面的基础信息区域查看
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the results in reverse chronological order. Valid values:

true: Results are displayed in reverse chronological order of device activity time. The most recent device activity is displayed first, and the earliest device activity is displayed last.

false: Results are displayed in chronological order of device activity time. The earliest device activity is displayed first, and the most recent device activity is displayed last.

If this parameter is not specified, results are displayed in chronological order by default
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果是否倒序显示。取值说明如下：

true：按照设备活动时间倒序显示，最后一次的设备活动信息显示在第一条，最早一次的设备活动信息显示在最后一条。

false：按照设备活动时间顺序显示，最早一次的设备活动信息显示在第一条，最后一次的设备活动信息显示在最后一条。

若不输入，则返回结果默认按照设备活动时间顺序显示
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en: The client ID of the device whose trace information you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询轨迹信息的设备的Client ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的起始时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的终止时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. If the value of this parameter exceeds the total number of pages, an empty result is returned
parameters.help_zh: 当前取第几页消息，从1开始递增。若输入参数大于总页数，则返回结果为空
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of MSMQ to display on each page for paging. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询，每页最多显示的消息数量，最小1条，最多100条
parameters.name: page_size

DeviceInfoList.description_en: The details of the device activity entries
DeviceInfoList.description_zh: 查询的设备活动信息明细

Action.description_en:
The device action. Valid values:

connect: The client requests a connection to the server.

close: The TCP connection is closed.

disconnect: The client requests to disconnect from the server
Action.description_zh:
设备动作。取值说明如下：

connect：客户端请求与服务端连接。

close：TCP连接断开。

disconnect：客户端请求与服务端断开连接

ActionCode.description_en:
The return code of the device action. Valid values:

mqtt.trace.action.connect: returned when the device action is connect.

mqtt.trace.action.close: returned when the device action is close.

mqtt.trace.action.disconnect: returned when the device action is disconnect
ActionCode.description_zh:
设备动作的返回码。取值说明如下：

mqtt.trace.action.connect：设备动作为connect时返回该参数值。

mqtt.trace.action.close：设备动作为close时返回该参数值。

mqtt.trace.action.disconnect：设备动作为disconnect时返回该参数值

ActionInfo.description_en:
The description of the device action. Valid values:

accepted: The server accepts the connection request from the client.

not authorized: The TCP connection is closed because the permission verification of the instance accessed by the client fails.

clientId conflict: The TCP connection is closed because of a client ID conflict.

resource auth failed: The TCP connection is closed because the permission verification of the topic or group ID resource accessed by the client fails.

no heart: The TCP connection is closed because no heartbeat is detected from the client.

closed by client: The TCP connection is closed because of a client exception.

disconnected by client: The client requests to disconnect.

invalid param: The TCP connection is closed because of invalid request parameters.

Socket IOException: The TCP connection is closed because of network jitter or packet loss
ActionInfo.description_zh:
设备动作的描述信息。取值说明如下：

accepted：服务端接收客户端发起的连接请求。

not authorized：客户端访问的实例权限校验失败导致TCP连接断开。

clientId conflict：客户端标识冲突导致TCP连接断开。

resource auth failed：客户端访问的Topic或Group ID资源权限校验失败导致TCP连接断开。

no heart：客户端无心跳导致TCP连接断开。

closed by client：客户端异常导致TCP连接断开。

disconnected by client：客户端请求断开连接。

invalid param：请求参数不合法导致TCP连接断开。

Socket IOException：网络抖动或丢包导致TCP连接断开

ChannelId.description_en: The connection identifier of the device

Time.description_en: The time when the device action occurred

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of device activity entries displayed per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页最多显示的设备活动信息数量

RequestId.description_en: A common parameter. Each request has a unique ID that is active for troubleshooting and locating issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

Total.description_en: The total number of device activity entries returned
Total.description_zh: 查询到的设备活动信息总数
